**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | Allowlisted (tea bags are plastic-free) |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | Allowlisted |
| "Recommended by nutritionists" | Unsupported. It's social proof and a health-adjacent endorsement, with no source in the allowlist or this chat. |

**Problems**

1. "Recommended by nutritionists" is an invented endorsement. Nothing in the brand policy backs it, and it implies a health benefit, which is regulated territory and likely to trip ad platform policies. Remove it. If there is a real, sourced endorsement, supply it and it can be reconsidered: `[PROOF NEEDED: named nutritionist or body who recommends the tea, with source]`.
2. The landing page must also make any claim that appears in the ad. The nutritionist claim has no support anywhere, so it can't stay.

The two plastic-free and compostable claims are fine. Note the ad doesn't say what "home compostable" is certified to, but the policy lists it as a backable claim, so no change is needed.

**Compliant version**

Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery over £25.

(The delivery line is optional, drawn from the allowlist. Check your character limits; I haven't been given any, so I haven't counted.)

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Recommended by nutritionists.", "type": "health_claim"}, {"quote": "Recommended by nutritionists.", "type": "fake_testimonial"}], "publish": false}
```
